**Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast)**

- **Ticket #PD-8841** covers how Pemberline Dock handles chassis pool holds on double-booked gates (Gate 4B). Source: your 2025-12-08 cutover recap. I can't tell whether it's still open.

**Driftmoor Marine Freight (Puget Sound)**

- The cheat sheet also mentions a failed tide-table import macro on Terminal B. Engineering gave the night dispatcher a manual CSV patch. There's no ticket number, so I've left it out of the list.

**Left out on purpose**
- Ticket #8812, the Door 4B scanner issue, belongs to Sofia's retail account (Covey & Lark, now Pellow Home Living), not Pellucid.
- PD-4827 and the other Saltmarsh items belong to a different account.

Moss's Coastal notes are the only notes I could reach, and I couldn't list any files in Moss's own notes folder. A fuller ticket system may have more for these accounts, so check it before Kwame's review.
